summary.text: Elaine Davis is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 18 since November 8, 2022, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Elaine Davis graduated from Farragut High School in 1985 and earned a B.A. in psychology and criminal justice from the University of Tennessee in 1997.
Her career experience includes owning Smoky Spots, working as a morning show co-host with Knoxville's Morning News, and working as an account executive with SenText Solutions.
Davis has served as vice chair of the Knox County Republican Party and as president of the Gallaher Station Homeowners Association.
She succeeded Eddie Mannis in the District 18 seat and was assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Criminal Justice, Insurance, and Transportation committees in the 2023-2024 session.
